name: text
title: Text
description: Body text with a size and tone from the scale.
a11y: A plain p (or the child with asChild); tone is never the only signal, so pair danger text with words.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Colour role: `default`, `muted`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` or `accent`, the same names as Alert. Never rely on colour alone to carry meaning.
`ok` still works.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Lets the text run the full width of its container. By default a paragraph stops at a readable line length (`--measure`). Default false.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child (a span, label, li) with the text styles.

usage:
import {Text} from '@monoline/react';
